title: On Finishing the wall before the rains
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：finish　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 finish 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the counsellor ① finished the wall before the rains twice over, and every listener in the garden said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three evenings on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the counsellor ② finishes the wall before the rains year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ finish the wall before the rains at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ finished the wall before the rains before — a line in the journal for June 1953 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Finishing the wall before the rains twice over, the counsellor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the letter at the far bench, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ finish the letter with one line year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Finish the letter with one line at once and never mention it again.

By 1966 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the journal, and a new listener from the next garden ⑧ finishes the letter with one line twice over every evening without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the bench, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ finished the wall before the rains again when nobody else would.

⑩ To finish the wall before the rains, my mother said in 1971, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the garden remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the garden forgets, somebody finishes the wall before the rains year after year again and somebody must finish the wall before the rains twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 完成（一般过去式 finished the wall before the rains：1959 年谈心人头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 完成（一般现在 finishes the wall before the rains：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 完成（不定式 to finish the wall before the rains：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 完成（过去完成时 had finished the wall before the rains：1953 年六月的心记上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 完成（动名词 finishing the wall before the rains 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 结束（finish the letter with one line：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去结束用一句话给那封信收尾）
G. v. 结束（finish the letter with one line：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 完成（后段两处：新来的倾听者照例 finishes the letter with one line，而母亲又一次 finished the wall before the rains）

finish 意为“完成”，结尾那句是母亲 1971 年的话：要完成雨季前把墙砌完，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和小园记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 finish 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the counsellor finished the wall before the rains twice over, and nobody in the garden forgot it.
Even now the counsellor finishes the wall before the rains year after year whenever the garden asks.
Finishing the wall before the rains twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever finish the letter with one line year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
